verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to WezTerm. Direct probes found nothing to point an agent at: https://wezterm.org/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and the markdown docs variant (features.html.md) also returned HTTP 404. The documented CLI and headless control loop are a separate capability, and nothing in the pack describes docs written for agents.
